title: one-repo real-world validation

dependencyPrep.notes: MCP first-pass scan found no local $schema refs; dependency install is not needed for schema fidelity. Lockfiles: package-lock.json. Remote schema refs: 0.

findings: CLI output was understandable for .github/FUNDING.yml: it grouped 8 blank-provider issues and 2 catalog validation-context issues, showed exact lines/properties, and suggested removing unused provider keys or adding valid provider values.

The FUNDING.yml source excerpts show template-style blank keys such as patreon, ko_fi, tidelift, and custom being parsed as null, so the validation findings look correct and actionable for a developer cleaning up that file.

Coverage was partly limited: vercel.json matched the SchemaStore Vercel catalog entry but was skipped because https://openapi.vercel.sh/vercel.json failed to compile. The warning explains this is not a finding in the file, but the developer still loses validation for a common hand-authored config file.

Skipped coverage was visible and grouped by reason, including vercel.json as medium-signal external catalog unavailable, app.json as schema-less custom file, and package-lock.json as low-signal lockfile.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Improve handling of catalog schemas that fail to compile, starting with the SchemaStore Vercel schema.
productRecommendations.rationale: In this repo, vercel.json was discovered as a common config file but skipped because the catalog schema failed to compile. The warning was clear, yet the developer loses useful validation coverage for a file DollarLint can identify.

productDecisions: No product change made during this one-repo sweep; recorded Vercel catalog schema compilation as a coverage signal for follow-up.
followUp: Investigate why the catalog Vercel schema at https://openapi.vercel.sh/vercel.json fails to compile and whether DollarLint can support, patch, or suppress unsupported schema features more gracefully.
validationFeedback.notes: DollarLint mostly behaved well on the actionable FUNDING.yml findings and was transparent about skipped files, but the external Vercel schema compile failure is a product/coverage signal because it prevents validation of a common config file inferred from the catalog.
